# S2 browser bundle

- Package: `s2js` 1.44.0, community JavaScript/TypeScript port by Peter Johnson.
- Upstream: https://github.com/missinglink/s2js
- Pinned browser bundle: https://esm.sh/s2js@1.44.0/es2022/s2js.bundle.mjs
- Saved locally as `s2js-1.44.0.es.js`; no runtime CDN import is required.
- Bundled dependency: `bigfloat` 0.1.1 (MIT).
- Included licenses: `S2JS-LICENSE.txt` (Apache-2.0) and `BIGFLOAT-LICENSE.txt` (MIT).
- The source-map trailer was removed because the source map is not distributed here.

The application wrapper is readable in `js/grid-s2.js`. The minified vendor bundle is third-party code, not intended for manual application edits. Update the pinned bundle and its licenses deliberately if changing versions.
